title: AIGW Client Projection
question: How does AIGW turn one reviewed configuration into guarded native projections in every admitted client?
summary: AIGW keeps Accounts, Routes and Client Bindings in one locked configuration and its Tokens in one selected store, and projects each client's bounded region through one adapter seam as a guarded, compensated transaction. It never carries a request.
scope: The AIGW program as released at v0.6.0: its production Go packages, the command entry point, the team manifest and go.mod.
limits: Each component cites every production file the rules attribute to it; a relation cites the files of the packages that import the other component.
Tests, their inputs and the repository's tools, CI and documentation are outside the scope.
attribution: Architecture Publications, read from the AIGW source

exclude.reason: Go keeps each package's tests beside its code; they are not its architecture.

details.commands: setup, use, sync, check, verify, rotate, rollback, doctor, update and more
details.shape: one package per command, sharing behaviour only through invocation

details.serves: a client's own Token on demand, never on standard output

details.renders: human and JSON output, prompts and errors; imports no use case

details.returns: values that several commands share, for the terminal to render

details.migrates: an Account or Route identity in two phases

details.classifies: the enabled-client scope of an operation

details.commits: one configuration transition with guarded compensation

details.states: configured, endpoint checked, inference checked, deferred, degraded, invalid, unavailable

details.observes: bounded, redacted endpoint and authentication health

details.lists: the built-in adapters in admission order

details.proves: every adapter against one contract suite

details.observes: the host's clients and paths without adopting them

details.projects: a bounded region of ~/.codex/config.toml and its model catalog
its provider catalog, protocol and model

details.installs: a verified portable program, one predecessor kept

details.owns: Account Tokens in one selected backend: native keyring, DPAPI or an owner-only file
config.toml under one lock, its checkpoint and schema migration
Accounts, Models, Routes, recommendations, Client Bindings and the team manifest
AIGW-owned paths, guarded file writes and their rollback, bounded child processes
